title: 1권 5유닛 장면 · 2
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: Further along the path: the trees with egg-, elf- and exit-sign fruits, with fan-, frog- and fork fruits, with goat-, gift- and guitar fruits, and with hen-, hippo- and hammer fruits — and every one of them is wearing a big striped nightcap pulled down over its leafy crown like a sleeping cap! Grumble stands on a wobbly wooden ladder against the hen tree, tying the last striped nightcap onto it, frowning with his tongue out in concentration; his lantern hangs on the ladder glowing softly. Bun and Hedgie stare up at the hatted trees with open mouths; Pip hovers beside a hat, puzzled. Hidden in the picture: a white egg in the grass, a green frog on a stone, the white goat peeking from behind a tree, the brown hen under the ladder. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
